usedFor: QuickBooks holds your invoices, and ActiveCampaign is where you market to the people on them. “New Invoice” in QuickBooks can add each one through “Create Contact” in ActiveCampaign.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Create Contact” in ActiveCampaign
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice brings a real paying customer into ActiveCampaign. The other direction records a QuickBooks payment when a contact is added, which a new contact does not mean.

watchOut: “New Invoice” is polling, so contacts appear after the next check. “Create Contact” makes a new contact, so a customer with several invoices runs it several times. Check how repeats are handled.
